ts-1.0.0.description:
This is a fully integrated version of the Taylor Swift Discography manual, now requiring the use of the Archipelago Music Client. 

To set it up, follow the setup guide [here](https://github.com/benny-dreamly/Archipelago/blob/taylor-swift/worlds/taylorswift/docs/setup_en.md) and don't forget to download the zip file, which contains the proper configuration files for setting up this APWorld with the music client. 

The .whl file is not for end users.
ts-1.0.0.title: Taylor Swift Discography 1.0.0
